versions.subject: Update azure_ad_user_added_to_sensitive_role.yml
versions.detection:
selection: 
    Operation: 'Add member to role.'
    Workload: 'AzureActiveDirectory'
    ModifiedProperties{}.NewValue|endswith:
        - 'Admins'
        - 'Administrator'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Operation="Add member to role." Workload="AzureActiveDirectory" "ModifiedProperties{}.NewValue" IN ("*Admins", "*Administrator")
